message: My Monday diabetes class conflicts with work now. Can I move it to Thursday afternoon? Please confirm if that time is available.
summary: Work conflicts with Monday’s diabetes class; requests Thursday afternoon and asks the clinic to confirm availability.

message: The portal will not accept my verification code. I need to submit a clinic form today; can someone help me log in?
summary: Cannot submit today’s clinic form because the portal rejects the verification code; requests sign-in help.

message: Please correct the wrong birth date on my clinic letter and send me a copy of my visit notes.
summary: Requests correction of the birth date on a clinic letter and a copy of visit notes.

message: I have been feeling sick since starting the tablets. Should I stop taking them? Please ask the care team to contact me.
summary: Reports feeling sick after starting medication and requests a care-team call about whether to stop.

message: I cannot make the appointment tomorrow. I am free on Friday morning instead, but the clinic has not confirmed a change.
summary: Cannot attend tomorrow’s appointment; requests Friday morning instead and notes that the change is unconfirmed.

message: My reminder says 8:30 but the letter from the clinic says 9:30. I have not changed the appointment. Could someone verify the start time before I travel?
summary: The reminder and letter show different start times; asks staff to confirm the time before travelling.

message: I completed the diabetes class, but the certificate has my first name misspelled. Could you correct it and email me the updated copy?
summary: Requests correcting a misspelled first name on the diabetes class certificate and emailing a new copy.

message: The clinic portal accepted my form, but I cannot tell whether it went to the records team. Please confirm which department received it.
summary: Asks which department received the form submitted through the portal.

message: I moved to a new address and want future clinic letters sent there. Please update my contact details, but keep my phone number the same.
summary: Requests updating the postal address for future letters while keeping the current phone number.

message: My prescription will run out before next week’s appointment. Could the clinical team review whether I need a refill?
summary: Prescription will run out before next week’s appointment; requests a clinical review for a refill.

message: My transport was cancelled, so I cannot get to the clinic on Monday. Could you check whether a phone appointment is possible? Please leave the original booking active for now.
summary: Cannot travel to Monday’s appointment because transport was cancelled; asks about a phone appointment and to keep the original booking active.

message: I attended the class but did not receive the take-home worksheet. Could you send the worksheet and confirm whether it is also available in large print?
summary: Requests the missing class worksheet and asks whether a large-print version is available.

message: The portal says my appointment is at the North clinic, but the letter says Central. I have not changed the booking; please check the correct location.
summary: Portal and letter show different clinic locations; asks staff to confirm the correct location without changing the booking.

message: I paid the balance by phone yesterday, but the account still shows an amount due. Please check the payment and send a receipt if it was processed.
summary: Paid the balance by phone yesterday; asks staff to check the account and send a receipt if payment was processed.

message: I have been vomiting since taking my medication this morning. Please ask the clinical team to call as soon as possible; I have not changed my dose.
summary: Reports vomiting after taking medication this morning and requests an urgent clinical-team call; says the dose is unchanged.

message: My class registration went through, but I need to switch from the Tuesday group to the Saturday group. Can you confirm there is space before changing it?
summary: Requests switching from Tuesday to Saturday class; asks staff to confirm space before making the change.

message: I posted my signed insurance form last Friday. It has not appeared in the portal yet; could you check whether it arrived by mail?
summary: Posted a signed insurance form last Friday; asks staff to check whether it arrived because it is not in the portal.

message: The clinic called my old number about an appointment. Please use the new number on the form I sent and tell me whether you received it.
summary: Requests using the new phone number from a submitted form and confirmation that the clinic received it.

message: My doctor asked me to track my readings for a week. I have finished the list and want to send it for review; where should I submit it?
summary: Has completed a week of readings and asks where to submit them for clinician review.

message: I need a copy of my discharge letter, and the portal will not open the documents page. Please send the letter and help with the access problem.
summary: Requests a discharge letter and help opening the portal documents page.

message: The clinic shuttle is not running on my appointment day. Could you check for a video visit instead? Please do not cancel the in-person appointment until I know whether video is possible.
summary: Requests checking whether a video visit is possible due to shuttle cancellation; asks staff to keep the in-person booking until confirmed.

message: I joined the education group last month but the follow-up booklet never arrived. Please resend it to my home address and tell me if there is a postage charge.
summary: Requests a replacement follow-up booklet at home and asks whether postage is charged.

message: I can sign in, but the portal shows another patient’s initials beside my appointment. Please check the record before I open any documents.
summary: Reports another patient’s initials beside an appointment and asks staff to check the record before opening documents.

message: My payment receipt has the wrong date and the amount is correct. Please issue a corrected receipt without changing the amount paid.
summary: Requests correcting the receipt date while leaving the payment amount unchanged.

message: After taking my medication I developed swelling around my lips. I have not taken more; please get a clinician to call me urgently.
summary: Reports lip swelling after medication, has taken no more, and requests an urgent clinician call.

message: I need to move from the Monday class to the Wednesday one because of a work change. Please check there is space before removing my Monday place.
summary: Requests moving from Monday to Wednesday class due to work; asks staff to confirm space before releasing the current place.

message: I sent the insurance referral by fax on Friday. The appointment is next week and I need to know whether it arrived before then.
summary: Faxed an insurance referral Friday; asks whether it arrived before next week’s appointment.

message: Please add my interpreter preference to the appointment notes. I can attend tomorrow, but the clinic has not confirmed that an interpreter is available.
summary: Requests adding an interpreter preference and notes that availability for tomorrow is unconfirmed.

message: My readings log is complete, and the portal upload worked. Could you confirm that the clinical team can see it before my appointment on Thursday?
summary: Completed and uploaded a readings log; asks whether the clinical team can see it before Thursday’s appointment.

message: Please send my appointment letter again. Also, remove my old mobile number from the contact details; I no longer use it.
summary: Requests a resent appointment letter and removal of an old mobile number from contact details.

message: The booking page lists my appointment at East Clinic, while my reminder says West Clinic. Please confirm the location before I arrange a ride; do not change the time.
summary: Requests confirmation of the appointment location because the booking page and reminder conflict; asks staff not to change the time.

message: I attended the workshop but the promised recipe booklet was not included. Could you send it in large print and confirm whether it covers vegetarian meals?
summary: Requests the missing recipe booklet in large print and asks if it includes vegetarian meals.

message: The portal says my contact details were updated, but the confirmation went to the old email. Please check which email is now on my account.
summary: Asks staff to confirm which email is on the account after an update confirmation went to the old address.

message: I need a copy of the letter sent to my insurance company last week. Please include the date it was sent and the recipient department.
summary: Requests a copy of last week’s insurance letter, including its sent date and recipient department.

message: My new medicine caused a rash and I have stopped taking it. Please contact the clinician who prescribed it and let me know when they can call.
summary: Reports a rash and stopping the new medicine; requests contact with the prescriber and a call time.

message: The clinic says my payment has cleared but the portal still blocks appointment booking. Please check whether the billing status is updated before I try again.
summary: Payment has cleared but portal booking remains blocked; asks staff to check the billing status.

message: Could you move my class registration from the morning to an afternoon session? I can attend any day except Thursday; please confirm before cancelling my current place.
summary: Requests an afternoon class on any day except Thursday and asks for confirmation before releasing the current place.

message: I sent the clinic a new emergency contact form by post ten days ago. Could you verify it arrived and update the contact if it has been processed?
summary: Posted a new emergency-contact form ten days ago; asks staff to verify receipt and update the contact if processed.

message: I feel shaky after lunch and my reading is lower than the range my clinician gave me. Please have the clinical team call; I am not asking for a dose change by email.
summary: Reports shakiness and a reading below the clinician-provided range; requests a clinical-team call, not an emailed dose change.

message: The appointment is still booked for Monday, but I need to ask whether a support person can attend. Please confirm the visitor policy without changing the booking.
summary: Asks whether a support person may attend Monday’s appointment and requests the policy without changing the booking.

message: The appointment letter says to use the rear entrance, but the accessibility note says the lift is at the front. Could someone confirm the accessible entrance before Thursday?
summary: Requests confirmation of Thursday’s accessible entrance because the letter and access note conflict.

message: I received the diabetes class audio link, but it expires before the session next week. Please send a link that will remain available until then.
summary: Requests a replacement audio link that remains available through next week’s class.

message: The portal says my consent form is complete, but the clinic text says it is missing. Please confirm the status before I upload it again.
summary: Asks staff to resolve conflicting consent-form statuses before reuploading.

message: My clinic notes were sent to my former address. Please confirm the new address is on file and tell me whether the notes can be resent.
summary: Requests confirmation that the new address is on file and asks whether clinic notes can be resent.

message: My insurer approved the referral, but the clinic portal still blocks booking. Please check whether the approval is recorded before I call to schedule.
summary: Asks staff to check whether insurer approval is recorded because the portal still blocks booking.

message: My appointment is still confirmed, but the reminder gives the wrong bus stop. Please confirm the clinic entrance and transport stop without changing the booking.
summary: Requests confirming the entrance and bus stop; asks staff to keep the confirmed appointment unchanged.

message: I borrowed the diabetes guide from the library and need a copy for myself. Could you send the same edition in large print?
summary: Requests a personal large-print copy of the same diabetes guide edition.

message: The portal shows my referral as sent, but the insurer says nothing arrived. Please check the transmission date and resend if needed.
summary: Requests checking the referral transmission date and resending if the insurer did not receive it.

message: Please update my emergency contact but do not use that person as my appointment contact. Send appointment messages to me by email.
summary: Requests an emergency-contact update while keeping appointment messages directed to the patient by email.

message: I have a question about a new symptom and a separate request for my visit notes. Please have a clinician call and mail the notes to my home.
summary: Requests a clinician call about a new symptom and postal delivery of visit notes.

message: My appointment moved to Friday, but the transport company still has the old date. Please confirm the new booking and tell me what proof to send them.
summary: Requests confirmation of Friday’s appointment change and asks what proof to send the transport company.

message: The portal lists my class as cancelled, but I received a joining link today. Please check whether I am enrolled before sending another link.
summary: Asks staff to verify class enrollment because the portal and joining link conflict.

message: I paid the clinic by bank transfer on the 4th. Please confirm the payment is on my account and update the statement if it has cleared.
summary: Requests confirmation of the 4th’s bank transfer and an updated statement if payment cleared.

message: My new insurance approval is for the East clinic, but my appointment is at Central. Please check whether the approval covers this location before the visit.
summary: Asks whether the insurance approval covers the Central clinic appointment.

message: I accidentally took the evening medicine in the morning. I feel okay, but please ask a clinician to call before my next scheduled dose.
summary: Reports taking the evening medicine in the morning and requests clinician contact before the next dose.

message: The letter says my records were posted on Monday, but nothing has arrived. Could you verify the address and arrange a replacement if necessary?
summary: Requests checking the postal address and arranging replacement records if Monday’s mailing cannot be delivered.

message: I registered for the Saturday session but need to leave at noon. Please confirm the finish time and whether I can receive the materials afterwards.
summary: Asks for Saturday session’s finish time and whether materials can be sent if leaving at noon.

message: The portal has my old email and I cannot receive the reset link. Please update my email from the form I submitted and help me sign in.
summary: Requests updating the email from a submitted form and portal sign-in help because reset links go to the old email.

message: I need the clinic to confirm whether my prescription review is booked. The pharmacy says a refill is waiting for clinic approval.
summary: Requests confirmation of a prescription review because a refill awaits clinic approval.

message: Please send the visit summary to my secure email, not the shared family email on file. Confirm once the address has been changed.
summary: Requests a visit summary to a secure email instead of the shared family email and asks for confirmation of the address change.
